交付 crash matrix 與重播紀錄，明確區分 transport delivery 與 business effect。

optionsEn: Processing before commit allows replay; committing first risks loss. Kafka transactions do not automatically cover arbitrary external databases.
Deliver crash matrix and replay traces,distinguishing delivery from business effects.

Study Kafka: at-least-once replay and side-effect deduplication as a named design investigation. Compare crash outcomes when effects precede offset commits versus the reverse. Read the relevant source concepts,then reproduce the explicit data contract; a product name is not validation.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「處置與重新驗證」。交付 crash matrix 與重播紀錄，明確區分 transport delivery 與 business effect。 與本階段判準一起判讀：先處理後提交可重播，先提交後處理可遺失；Kafka 內部交易不自動涵蓋任意外部資料庫。 交付可供另一人重建的輸入表，任何自行加入的假設需另列。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies disposition and re-verification. Deliver crash matrix and replay traces,distinguishing delivery from business effects. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Processing before commit allows replay; committing first risks loss. Kafka transactions do not automatically cover arbitrary external databases. steps.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: Data contracts,interfaces and invariants · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「資料契約、介面與不變量」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Data contracts,interfaces and invariants and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
建立soft-v29-112-evidence資料夾，交付input.csv或事件表、基準推算、變更後結果、故障判讀與驗收紀錄。交付 crash matrix 與重播紀錄，明確區分 transport delivery 與 business effect。 保存來源網址、執行環境及明示的模型界限。
在交接件中加入「資料契約、介面與不變量」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：先處理後提交可重播，先提交後處理可遺失；Kafka 內部交易不自動涵蓋任意外部資料庫。 交付可供另一人重建的輸入表，任何自行加入的假設需另列。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：比較先做副作用再提交 offset 與相反順序的當機結果。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Create soft-v29-112-evidence with input.csv or an event table,baseline calculations,changed outcomes,diagnosis and acceptance records. Deliver crash matrix and replay traces,distinguishing delivery from business effects. Retain source URL,runtime and model limits.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Data contracts,interfaces and invariants: Processing before commit allows replay; committing first risks loss. Kafka transactions do not automatically cover arbitrary external databases. Deliver reconstructible input tables and list every added assumption.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Compare crash outcomes when effects precede offset commits versus the reverse. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。先處理後提交可重播，先提交後處理可遺失；Kafka 內部交易不自動涵蓋任意外部資料庫。 交付可供另一人重建的輸入表，任何自行加入的假設需另列。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Processing before commit allows replay; committing first risks loss. Kafka transactions do not automatically cover arbitrary external databases. Deliver reconstructible input tables and list every added assumption.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量
stages.description: 比較先做副作用再提交 offset 與相反順序的當機結果。 消費 offset 0,1,2，效果為 +5,+7,+3；在 offset1 效果後但提交前當機。 將鍵、型別、時間或版本欄分列，指出每筆資料的唯一身份；對NULL、重複或無限邊界做明確約定。
stages.descriptionEn: Compare crash outcomes when effects precede offset commits versus the reverse. Consume offsets 0,1,2 with effects +5,+7,+3; crash after offset1’s effect before its commit. Tabulate keys,types,time/version fields and stable identities; explicitly handle NULLs,duplicates and unbounded endpoints.
